controls.label: record_toggle
controls.note: Button 1 (col 1 top) — toggles record/play. First press: 2-bar count-in then record. Press again while recording: stop + loop. Press while playing: restart.

controls.label: user_volume
controls.note: Fader 1 (col 1 middle) — user loop stem volume [0.0–1.0]

controls.label: voice_0_volume
controls.note: Fader 2 (col 2 middle) — AI Voice 1 stem volume [0.0–1.0]

controls.label: voice_1_volume
controls.note: Fader 3 (col 3 middle) — AI Voice 2 stem volume [0.0–1.0]

controls.label: voice_2_volume
controls.note: Fader 4 (col 4 middle) — AI Voice 3 stem volume [0.0–1.0]

controls.label: eq_bass
controls.note: Knob 1 (col 1 bottom) — EQ Bass ±12 dB low shelf @ 250 Hz. Center (CC 64) = 0 dB.

controls.label: eq_mid
controls.note: Knob 2 (col 2 bottom) — EQ Mid ±12 dB peaking @ 1 kHz Q=0.707. Center (CC 64) = 0 dB.

controls.label: eq_treble
controls.note: Knob 3 (col 3 bottom) — EQ Treble ±12 dB high shelf @ 4 kHz. Center (CC 64) = 0 dB.

controls.label: reverb_wet
controls.note: Knob 4 (col 4 bottom) — Reverb wet mix [0.0–1.0]. Full left = dry, full right = large hall.
